original_obligation.quoted_target: Compose the actual nonlinear optical remainder with the preserved arbitrary-shear exact inverse and the separately conditioned H-not-equal-zero truncated inverse, using explicit Euclidean constants and retaining the zero-H invertible branch.
explicit_assumptions: Remainder bounds additionally use D symmetric and q(beta)<1 or 0<=eNorm(beta)<=r<1.
Truncation branch: H D != 0, separately from invertibility.
Positive boost branch and source conventions are inherited from reviewed dependencies.

scope.conclusion: Exact nonlinear inversion-error identities and bounds, separate H-not-equal-zero truncation identities and bounds, and a zero-H invertible exact-only control.
not_claimed: uniform control at singular D or H=0

theorem_signature:
theorem exact_inverse_linear (D : M3) (beta : V3) (hdet : D.det ≠ 0) : beta = exactEstimate D (linearSignal D beta)

theorem exact_inverse_nonlinear_defect (D : M3) (beta : V3) (hdet : D.det ≠ 0) : beta - exactEstimate D (dipoleMap D beta) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (D⁻¹).mulVec (remainder D beta)

theorem exact_inverse_error_le_remainder (D : M3) (beta : V3) (hdet : D.det ≠ 0) : eNorm (beta - exactEstimate D (dipoleMap D beta)) ≤ (opNorm (D⁻¹) / 2) * eNorm (remainder D beta)

theorem exact_inverse_error_pointwise (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (hdet : D.det ≠ 0) (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : eNorm (beta - exactEstimate D (dipoleMap D beta)) ≤ (opNorm (D⁻¹) * opNorm D / (1 - q beta)) * eNorm beta ^ 3

theorem exact_inverse_error_ball (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (hdet : D.det ≠ 0) (beta : V3) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta ≤ r) : eNorm (beta - exactEstimate D (dipoleMap D beta)) ≤ (opNorm (D⁻¹) * opNorm D / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 3 ∧ eNorm (beta - exactEstimate D (dipoleMap D beta)) ≤ (r * opNorm (D⁻¹) * opNorm D / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 2

theorem trunc_linear_defect (D : M3) (beta : V3) (hH : H D ≠ 0) : beta - truncEstimate D hH (linearSignal D beta) = linearDefect D hH beta

theorem trunc_nonlinear_defect (D : M3) (beta : V3) (hH : H D ≠ 0) : beta - truncEstimate D hH (dipoleMap D beta) = linearDefect D hH beta + (1 / (2 * H D)) • (1 - (1 / H D) • sigma D).mulVec (remainder D beta)

theorem trunc_nonlinear_residual_le_remainder (D : M3) (beta : V3) (hH : H D ≠ 0) : eNorm ((beta - truncEstimate D hH (dipoleMap D beta)) - linearDefect D hH beta) ≤ truncGain D hH * eNorm (remainder D beta)

theorem trunc_error_ball (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (hH : H D ≠ 0) (beta : V3) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta ≤ r) : eNorm (beta - truncEstimate D hH (dipoleMap D beta)) ≤ (opNorm (sigma D) ^ 2 / (H D)^2) * eNorm beta + truncGain D hH * (2 * opNorm D / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 3 ∧ eNorm (beta - truncEstimate D hH (dipoleMap D beta)) ≤ (opNorm (sigma D) ^ 2 / (H D)^2) * eNorm beta + truncGain D hH * (2 * r * opNorm D / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 2

theorem zeroH_exact_only_control : H CAS03C03.zeroHD = 0 ∧ CAS03C03.zeroHD.det = -2 ∧ ¬ (H CAS03C03.zeroHD ≠ 0)

theorem zeroH_exact_error_ball (beta : V3) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta ≤ r) : eNorm (beta - exactEstimate CAS03C03.zeroHD (dipoleMap CAS03C03.zeroHD beta)) ≤ (opNorm (CAS03C03.zeroHD⁻¹) * opNorm CAS03C03.zeroHD / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 3
accepted_lemma_signatures: eNorm ((A * B).mulVec v) <= opNorm A * opNorm B * eNorm v
eNorm ((1 - (1/H) • sigma).mulVec v) <= (1 + opNorm sigma / |H|) * eNorm v

commands.purpose: Compile the byte-identical PR492 Lean source once as an import dependency without rerunning its campaign.
Compile all frozen synthesis targets against the exact dependency binaries.

acceptance: All eleven exact frozen target signatures compile without changed premises, norms, constants, signs, or definitions.
The exact inverse and truncation results consume the byte-identical PR492 source once; historical four-axis execution is not rerun.
Zero-H invertibility is proved as an exact-inverse-only control and never admitted to the truncation branch.
Final target types and axioms are printed; only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound are allowed.
Every first failure and final source/import/output/argv/cwd/stdout/stderr/exit identity is preserved.
The author does not stage, commit, push, or edit outside allowed_files.
